title: Create web/dashboard.html and web/styles.css: the page links styles.css, uses at least three CSS classes that are all defined in styles.css, and has no inline style attributes and no <style> blocks.
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import pathlib, re
page = pathlib.Path("web/dashboard.html").read_text()
css = pathlib.Path("web/styles.css").read_text()
assert not re.search(r"\sstyle\s*=", page) and "<style" not in page.lower()
assert re.search(r"<link[^>]+href=[\"'"'"']styles\.css[\"'"'"']", page)
used = {c for group in re.findall(r"class=[\"'"'"']([^\"'"'"']+)[\"'"'"']", page) for c in group.split()}
defined = set(re.findall(r"\.([A-Za-z_][\w-]*)\s*[,{:]", css))
assert len(used) >= 3 and used <= defined, (used, defined)'
